sn47.39:1.1: “Bhikkhus, I will teach you the development of the four establishments of mindfulness.
sn47.39:1.3: “What, bhikkhus, is the development of the four establishments of mindfulness?
sn47.39:1.4: Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu dwells contemplating the body in the body, ardent, clearly comprehending, mindful, having removed covetousness and displeasure in regard to the world.
sn47.39:1.5: He dwells contemplating feelings in feelings …
sn47.39:1.7: phenomena in phenomena, ardent, clearly comprehending, mindful, having removed covetousness and displeasure in regard to the world.
sn47.39:1.8: This, bhikkhus, is the development of the four establishments of mindfulness.”
